messages:
marta: Hey @jamie — I pulled up ticket #63421. You reported that users get prompted for MFA immediately after SSO and sometimes get logged out, right?
jamie: Yeah that's it. They complete SSO, land back in the app, then within 20-60s they see 'Session expired, please re-authenticate' and the MFA prompt. Happens across Chrome/Edge. Started Friday after our IdP patch.
marta: Do you have repro steps you can share? Any logs or HAR?
jamie: Repro steps: 1) Click 'Sign in with Corp SSO' 2) Complete SSO 3) Redirect back to app with auth cookie 4) App calls /api/v1/session/refresh a few seconds later -> 401 -> app forces re-login -> loop. HAR attached in ticket.
marta: Are you running inside an iframe or top-level? And are there any proxies/VPNs?
jamie: Running inside our customer portal iframe (embedded app), some users on corporate VPN. External contractors (not behind corp portal) are fine.
marta: Noted. Two quick hypotheses: 1) cookie attributes changed (SameSite/Secure) causing browsers to block third-party cookie in iframe, so refresh fails; 2) refresh token TTL or rotation race. Can you paste the Set-Cookie header you see after initial login?
jamie: From HAR response headers (after initial redirect):

  Set-Cookie: session=abc123def; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=None

It looks like Secure is missing in some of the responses. The first login sometimes includes Secure, then the subsequent Set-Cookie in the rotation doesn't.
marta: If SameSite=None is present without Secure, modern Chrome treats it as Lax/invalid; third-party cookie will be blocked in an iframe. That would cause the app to not send a valid session cookie to /session/refresh, leading to 401.
ryan: We rolled out cookie rotation Friday evening as part of the IdP edge upgrade. The rotation script toggles flags based on backend health. I see a race in logs where one edge returns Set-Cookie without Secure when talking to the older token-rotate service. Pasting log snippet:```
[2024-06-21T18:12:03Z] edge-12 token-rotate response: Set-Cookie: session=xyz; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=None
[2024-06-21T18:12:03Z] edge-12 WARN missing Secure flag on cookie for session xyz
[2024-06-21T18:12:03Z] token-rotate v2 responded with reissue=true
```
marta: That matches the HAR — initial cookie had Secure, rotated cookie lost it. In cross-site iframe the browser will drop the cookie and the refresh call won't send credentials -> 401 -> client triggers full login and we get a new cookie -> sometimes it rotates again -> loop.
sarah: I can push an edge nginx config to rewrite Set-Cookie and force Secure + SameSite=None on responses as a short-term fix. Also will add a healthcheck to the rotation path so older nodes don't return inconsistent flags.
marta: Can you also confirm the refresh flow behavior? What is the exact response body when refresh fails? Jamie, can you paste the 401 body?
jamie: 401 JSON from /api/v1/session/refresh: {"error":"invalid_refresh_token","message":"no valid session cookie"} and response headers show no Set-Cookie.
marta: OK. Action plan: 1) ry an to rollback the problematic rotation or patch to ensure Secure flag present on all nodes (canary first) 2) sarah to push nginx rewrite for Set-Cookie on zone-2 canary 3) support to advise customers about iframe workaround (open app in top-level tab) and request HARs if they continue to see loop.
ryan: Pushing patch to zone-2 canary now. Command I'm running:
```bash
kubectl -n idp rollout restart deployment/token-rotate --context=prod-zone-2
```
I'll watch logs, rolling back if errors.
ryan: Patch applied to zone-2 canary. I see Set-Cookie with Secure present now in the logs:
```
[2024-06-22T09:02:14Z] edge-22 token-rotate response: Set-Cookie: session=def456; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=None
```
marta: @jamie can you verify with a few affected users?
jamie: Quick smoke test: two users who reproduced earlier — both no longer see the immediate MFA loop. One user on corp VPN still hit a retry once, but then stable.
marta: Excellent. We'll leave canary for 2h and then roll to other zones. Follow-up: we'll also audit session rotation TTL and add server-side guard to avoid reissuing cookie twice within 30s.
ryan: I'll open INC ticket and link to this thread.
session-bot: Incident INC-2026-324 created by ryan: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-324 :rotating_light:
marta: Marking this solved for now. Work items: audit edges, reinforce cookie enforcement, add rotation guard, customer follow-ups. @jamie please reopen if you see reoccurrence. :white_check_mark:
